<b>Pollenicas</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are stationary floral foes that instinctively react to movement by spitting bursting pollen pellets.<ref>Pollenica [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Floral foe that reacts instinctively to movement nearby. Spits pellets of crackling pollen that burst on impact."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Pollenicas do not move, and once [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is in range, they use their only attack.<br>
To attack, Pollenicas launch four globs of pollen at Hornet, with a delay between each glob. The pollen moves slowly in the air and cannot be deflected, and may also travel at slightly different angles and arcs.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-threaded]] Pollenicas have their health doubled. They gain the [[Black-Threading#Movesets|Void Projectiles]] attack, which replaces their normal one.

== Location ==
Pollenicas can be found in [[Shellwood]], the [[Memorium]], and the [[Grand Gate]].

* Despite being described as floral creatures, Pollenicas drop organs for the <i>[[Broodfeast]]</i> or <i>[[Runtfeast]]</i> [[wish]]es.
